question:
Dimensional analysis of the equation
$$(\text{Velocity})^x = (\text{Pressure difference})^{3/2}\,(\text{Density})^{-3/2}$$
gives the value of $x$ as
solution:
Combine the right-hand side first: $\dfrac{\text{Pressure}}{\text{Density}} = \dfrac{[ML^{-1}T^{-2}]}{[ML^{-3}]} = [L^2T^{-2}]$

So the right-hand side is $\left(\dfrac{P}{\rho}\right)^{3/2} = [L^2T^{-2}]^{3/2} = [L^3T^{-3}] = [LT^{-1}]^3$

That is (velocity)$^3$, so $x = 3$.
